note: BH-9283: the first gap between two open-PR re-checks of a row that dfs_stop_check holds. After check c the next re-check is due min(POOL_WAIT_RECHECK_MIN * 2^(c-1), POOL_WAIT_RECHECK_MAX_MIN) minutes later (10, 20, 40, 80, 160, 240 ...). A tick that is not due holds the row with no read and no machine. 0 = re-check every tick (the BH-8880 behavior). Read as ${POOL_WAIT_RECHECK_MIN:-10}; a non-numeric value reads as 10.
